definitions.explanation: A student, typically at middle school or high school level.

examples.japanese: この{学校|がっこう}には{生徒|せいと}が500{人|にん}います。
examples.english: There are 500 students at this school.

examples.japanese: {生徒|せいと}たちは{熱心|ねっしん}に{勉強|べんきょう}しています。
{先生|せんせい}は{生徒|せいと}に{優|やさ}しいです。
examples.english: The teacher is kind to the students.

notes: 生徒 typically refers to middle and high school students. For elementary school, 児童 (じどう) is used. For university, 学生 (がくせい) is used. 生徒 combines 生 (life/person) and 徒 (follower/companion).
